role: Bootstrap procedural ontology (concepts, value nodes, and arithmetic/comparison procedures) into Co-Being knowledge graph on startup.
detail: Implements three dependency-ordered bootstrap layers: Layer 0 creates 8 ConceptPrimitive SCHEMA nodes (unit, zero, integer, set, sequence, more-than, less-than, same-as) and 21 ValueNode INSTANCE nodes (integers 0-20) plus INSTANCE_OF_CONCEPT edges; Layer 1 creates 3 counting primitives (successor, set_representation, count) as ProceduralTemplate nodes with ProcedureStep and WorkedExample children; Layer 2 creates 6 arithmetic/comparison procedures (add, subtract, multiply, compare_gt, compare_lt, compare_eq) with full AST bodies and worked examples. All nodes marked with TAUGHT_PROCEDURE provenance at confidence 1.0. Idempotent: checks node existence before creation. Main entry point bootstrap_procedural_ontology() runs all layers in order and returns ProceduralBootstrapResult with creation/existing counts.
gotchas: None detected — code is straightforward bootstrap logic. All procedures defined in static dicts with complete AST bodies and examples. Graph saves are wrapped with BootstrapError handling. Idempotency checked at ProceduralTemplate node level; assumes complete procedure exists if template exists.
